question: If a complete-semantics bounded-drift candidate is already an exact smaller incumbent on the current PrefixGraph-winning Shifted and Boundary rows, can that stronger external incumbent make a monotone PrefixGraph physical lower bound terminate enough prefix-compression trials to justify a safe suppression/productization rung?
changed_frame: The retired PrefixGraph lower-bound family compared anchors only against the current PrefixGraph incumbent. This court changes the incumbent with new representation evidence: a complete-semantics bounded-drift archive that is smaller than current PrefixGraph. The bound remains exact; only the threshold changes.
exact_lower_bound: HEADER.size + FOOTER.size + sum(final payload sizes already materialized for the anchor); both metadata copies and every future payload are gifted as zero bytes. Therefore any omitted physical component can only increase the final candidate.
required_precondition: The same run must show bounded drift eligible/resource-safe and complete bytes <= the exact current PrefixGraph winner before any PrefixGraph suppression credit exists.
measurements: trials spent before exact external-incumbent prune

survival_hurdle.rationale: Match the historical branch-bound materiality hurdle, but require it on both current decisive rows. Lower values are valid negative knowledge but insufficient to reopen PrefixGraph lower-bound productization.

kill_or_narrow: bounded drift is not a same-run exact smaller/equal incumbent on either decisive PrefixGraph winner
any suppression would change the exact selected bytes/tie law
prefix-trial reduction <20% on either decisive row
semantic, integrity, locality, or decode-unit drift
the court only recovers the same weak PrefixGraph-incumbent behavior without material extra pruning
claim_boundary: Research-only R3 headroom court. A green result may justify implementing exact early termination against an externally owned bounded-drift incumbent. It grants no product/runtime/release credit and does not authorize skipping PrefixGraph without the exact bound.
